record.issue_text: apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:43 — Error toast always builds "code: t(message)", so the unable_to_add_guests fallback is never used, and zod BAD_REQUEST errors show a raw JSON issues string

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` the `onError` handler always constructs `message` as a template string (`const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;`), which will be a non-empty string even when `err.data?.code` is undefined. Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)` will never hit the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback. Also, `t(err.message)` assumes `err.message` is a translation key; for TRPC/Zod validation errors this is often a non-key string (potentially verbose), so the toast can display an unhelpful/raw error string instead of a localized fallback.
